description: This PHP script handles the addition of dashboard pages in the SuiteCRM platform. It contains logic for displaying a form to input dashboard name and columns, as well as processing and saving the new dashboard page preferences for the current user.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating class used for rendering views within SuiteCRM.

methods.description: Retrieves user preferences related to dashboard pages.

methods.description: Sets user preferences for dashboard pages.
